AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: Ask your Casama bots for help, see what needs you, and run your routines.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Casama is the person's own team of AI bots. Use listBots to find a bot's exact name before askBot, and listRoutines before runRoutine. askBot starts a new chat each time and waits about 25 seconds for the reply; when the status is working, tell the person they will get a notification. Casama never approves or denies a request through an assistant: when the person wants to answer one, call openInCasama with place approval and the id from whatNeedsMe. Say the message field to the person; never invent a reply.
